title: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not check the publish status or the visitor's capabilities…
description: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin versions up to 4.4.6 improperly handle access control by not verifying the publish status or visitor capabilities before rendering popups requested via URL. This flaw allows unauthenticated users to view the content and configuration of popups that are still in draft or marked as private.
